description: Check a trust receipt's signature, revocation and chain coverage from inside this session (v1.0 receipts only; other profiles answer `unsupported_profile`, not invalid). LIMIT: the issuer verifies its own receipt (`verified_by: issuer`, `independent: false`), so this is a consistency check, not proof to a third party; `independent_verification` tells you how to verify it yourself against the public JWKS. Pass the `jws` from get_trust_receipt. Checkout guide: read the MCP resource trusteed://guides/checkout.

agent_key.description: Sandbox credential from `create_sandbox_key`. Use this when your client cannot set an `Authorization: Bearer` header.

jws.description: The compact JWS of the receipt (the `jws` field returned by get_trust_receipt).

name: verify_trust_receipt
